name: Goblin Skirmisher
notes: Nimble Escape: Hide or Disengage as bonus action every round. Never provokes opportunity attacks. Auto-flees at 4 HP or below — no morale check, they just run. Use in groups of 8-12 for suppression fire.
gm_notes: Role: harass, suppress, deny sight lines. Not here to fight in melee. 12 goblins firing creates constant pressure without being lethal — defenders must keep heads down (disadvantage on ranged if suppressed). Goblin culture: they flee competently, not stupidly. They WILL come back next round from a new position.
